notebook_cells.title: In [329]: Loss & Gradients
notebook_cells.source:
# for MSE
def MSE(X,Y,W,bias):
    n = len(Y)
    XW = X.dot(W)
    y_pred = XW + bias
    y_diff = y_pred - Y
    return (1/(2*n)) * (np.sum((y_diff)**2))

# partial derivative of Loss (MSE) w.r.t. W
def gradw(x,y,W,bias):
    n = len(y)
    y_pred = x.dot(W) + bias
    dlossdw = (1/n) * ((x.T).dot(y_pred - y))
    return dlossdw

# partial derivative of Loss (MSE) w.r.t. Bias
def gradb(x,y,W,bias):
    n = len(y)
    y_pred = x.dot(W) + bias
    dlossdb = (1/n) * np.sum(y_pred - y)
    return dlossdb

notebook_cells.title: Markdown [5]: Strategy 1
notebook_cells.source: Strategy 1: (Random with replacement)-for each epoch, run the update rules [ceiling(N/batch size)] times. Each time, take number of data points (batch size) uniformly randomly and update the parameters.

notebook_cells.title: In [330]: sgd_RWR
notebook_cells.source:
def sgd_RWR(X,Y,alpha=0.01,epochs=100,batch_size=240, bias=0):
    m, n = X.shape
    w = np.zeros(n)
    itt_per_epoch = int(np.ceil(m/batch_size))
    loss_plot = []
    for i in range(epochs):
        for j in range(itt_per_epoch):
            indexes = np.random.choice(m, size=batch_size, replace=True)
            X_batch = X[indexes]
            Y_batch = Y[indexes]
            dlossdw = gradw(X_batch, Y_batch, w, bias)
            w = w - (alpha * dlossdw)
            dlossdb = gradb(X_batch, Y_batch, w, bias)
            bias = bias - (alpha * dlossdb)
        loss = MSE(X, Y, w, bias)
        loss_plot.append(loss)
    return w, bias, loss_plot

notebook_cells.title: Markdown [6]: Strategy 2
notebook_cells.source: Strategy 2: (Random without replacement)- For each epoch, permute the data points randomly and create a list (say L). Divide this list into batches of the specified batch size and use each batch to update the model parameters.

notebook_cells.title: In [331]: sgd_RWOR
notebook_cells.source:
def sgd_RWOR(X,Y,alpha=0.01,epochs=100,batch_size=240,bias=0):
    m, n = X.shape
    w = np.zeros(n)
    loss_plot = []
    for i in range(epochs):
        indexes = np.random.permutation(m)
        X_permuted = X[indexes]
        Y_permuted = Y[indexes]
        for j in range(0, m, batch_size):
            X_batch = X_permuted[j:j+batch_size]
            Y_batch = Y_permuted[j:j+batch_size]
            dlossdw = gradw(X_batch, Y_batch, w, bias)
            w = w - (alpha * dlossdw)
            dlossdb = gradb(X_batch, Y_batch, w, bias)
            bias = bias - (alpha * dlossdb)
        loss = MSE(X, Y, w, bias)
        loss_plot.append(loss)
    return w, bias, loss_plot
